items.title: Paquito D'Rivera — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: the rest of the repertoire was music by Peter Gun... we started to avoid conflict with the government for playing foreign music

ctx.x: Nobody knows; suddenly, six months before that, we, I wanted to play that type of music. We play in the jam sessions very quietly, you know. In order to avoid that type of music, conflict with the government for playing and all that, we started to avoid conflict with the government for playing foreign music. So suddenly they decided to form this orchestra for playing foreign music. As simple as that, foreign music; most of the music—except for this one time I had a very Americanized arrangement of “Cuando…
Who was the director of this orchestra?
